title: OpenPA: Forced-alignment-free Multi-granular Pronunciation Assessment with Mixed-transcript Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13826v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in automatic pronunciation assessment (APA) have driven a shift from scripted to free-form assessment. However, existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines with forced alignment and separate feature extractors, limiting their practicality across response settings. In light of this, we propose OpenPA, a novel APA framework that leverages Whisper's cross-attention mechanism to jointly predict word- and utterance-level pronunciation scores without forced alignment. Through mixed-transcript adaptation and adaptive substitution weighting, OpenPA accommodates heterogeneous transcripts across closed- and open-response settings within a single model. Trained solely on speechocean762, OpenPA achieves the strongest overall performance among evaluated systems under in-domain closed and simulated open-response conditions, while maintaining its performance zero-shot on MultiPA. An additional cross-task evaluation on oral-ca

translated_title: OpenPA：无需强制对齐的多粒度发音评估与混合转录自适应
translated_abstract: 自动发音评估（APA）的最新进展推动了从脚本化评估向自由形式评估的转变。然而，现有方法通常依赖于包含强制对齐和独立特征提取器的多阶段流水线，限制了其在不同回答场景中的实用性。鉴于此，我们提出了OpenPA，这是一种新颖的APA框架，它利用Whisper的交叉注意力机制，在无需强制对齐的情况下联合预测单词级和话语级的发音分数。通过混合转录自适应和自适应替换加权，OpenPA能够在单一模型中适应封闭式和开放式回答场景中的异构转录。仅在speechocean762上训练，OpenPA在域内封闭式和模拟开放式回答条件下，在所有被评估系统中取得了最强的整体性能，同时在MultiPA上保持了零样本性能。此外还在口头ca…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出OpenPA框架，利用Whisper的交叉注意力机制实现无需强制对齐的单词级与话语级联合发音评估，并通过混合转录自适应使单一模型同时支持封闭式和开放式回答场景。
en_tdlr: OpenPA leverages Whisper's cross-attention mechanism to jointly predict word- and utterance-level pronunciation scores without forced alignment, and adapts to both closed- and open-response settings within a single model through mixed-transcript adaptation.
